sentences.en: They also note that while sadomasochistic fantasies are common, most of those who find such fantasies sexually arousing have no desire to experience the acts in real life.

sentences.en: There are, for instance, "gay" transsexuals, bisexual " swingers ", and lesbian sadomasochistic fetishists.

sentences.en: And the movie audience, like the 19th-century novel-reading public, can relish, with only slight queasiness, the sadomasochistic spectacle of boarding school cruelty.

sentences.en: Another contains a whirlpool bath and a large bin of beer cans, while a third contains sadomasochistic equipment, including chains on the wall and a cage.
